developmentChanges.title: Deadline validity hard check
developmentChanges.reason: Reject or quarantine freelance/job listings whose explicit delivery/application deadline is already past even when the marketplace still exposes the page as active; prevents stale marketplace pages from entering review.

developmentChanges.title: Hire saturation opportunity score
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance listings, combine proposal count with hires/interviews already recorded and client last-view recency; heavily penalize jobs where the buyer has effectively filled the role even if the page remains public.
